website_summary.name: English Article Decision Guide
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and professional interface featuring an interactive decision tree for choosing the correct English articles ("a," "an," "the," or none).
website_summary.appearance: The website is divided into two main sections. On the left side, there is an interactive decision tree diagram that guides users through a series of questions to determine the appropriate English article for a given noun. The tree uses blue paths for "Yes" answers and red paths for "No" answers, leading to circles indicating the final article choice. The right side contains explanatory text blocks detailing the rules and exceptions for using "a," "an," "the," and no article. These blocks are styled with headings, bullet points, and highlighted notes for clarity. The overall design is minimalistic, with a light background and well-spaced elements for easy readability.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers an interactive decision tree that users can navigate by clicking on "Yes" or "No" buttons corresponding to questions about the noun in question. It also provides detailed explanations and examples of article usage on the right-hand side. Users can hide the article explanation or reset the decision tree using buttons at the top. The content is educational, aiming to help users understand and apply the rules of English articles effectively.
